home.eco_description: ECOMONDO MEXICO integrates the Mobility of the Future sector by AMERICAS' Mobility of the Future , consolidating a comprehensive vision where smart, low-emission, efficient, and inclusive mobility is recognized as an essential component of sustainable development.
home.eco_desc_01: The mobility of the future is smart, inclusive, and circular.
home.eco_desc_02:
The mobility of the future represents a transformative paradigm that transcends transportation for people and goods to become a comprehensive ecosystem that responds to social, environmental, and economic needs.
With the support of ECOMONDO MEXICO , Latin America's environmental technology and circular economy fair, we will address the challenges of future mobility, seeking greater connectivity with efficient, low-emission transportation systems, as well as urban and logistics infrastructure that promotes optimal city planning by integrating micro-mobility and electromobility as sustainable alternatives for moving people and goods.

about_amof.title: Future Mobility Exhibition
about_amof.description:
AMERICAS’ mobility of the future, Expo & Summit, addresses the main challenges facing the mobility industry.

We bring together the main decision makers, key players and solution developers who are laying the groundwork to strengthen the value chain, infrastructure and complement public policies that will allow us to successfully move towards a smarter, more efficient and sustainable mobility.

summit.about_summit:
AMOF – SUMMIT in Aguascalientes seeks to drive the transformation of the current mobility in Mexico and Latin America, bringing innovation, technology and sustainability together in a single platform where all decision makers of the mobility future ecosystem converge.

The partnership between the Government of Aguascalientes, INA, and IGECO to organize this conference paves the way for more sustainable and efficient mobility in the region, addressing the areas of Smart Cities, Electric Vehicles, and Charging Solutions, as well as new transportation and micro-mobility technologies.
